vacancy_details.details: The recruitment notice invites applications for 1 vacancy (UIDAI may change the number at any time, in its discretion) for the post of Assistant Account Officer at the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Technology Centre, Bengaluru.

how_to_apply: Eligible and interested officers must submit their application online through the UIDAI Career Portal at https://career.uidai.gov.in.
After submission of the online application, download and print the duly filled online application form generated through the Career Portal.
Submit the signed hard copy of the application to your Cadre Controlling Authority or Parent Organisation for forwarding through proper channel.

Ensure the Cadre Controlling Authority forwards the application along with cadre clearance, vigilance/disciplinary clearance, ACRs/APARs for the last five years duly attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or an officer of equivalent rank, and the certificate in the prescribed format at Annex-I.

Forward the complete application along with all requisite documents to: Director (HR), Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Aadhaar Complex, NTI Layout, Tata Nagar, Kodigehalli, Technology Centre, Bengaluru – 560 092, so that it is received by 23 November 2026.
important_instructions: Individuals who apply for the post may not withdraw their candidature subsequently. Private candidates are not eligible as the post is filled on deputation basis. Only applications submitted online through the UIDAI Career Portal and subsequently forwarded through proper channel with all requisite documents will be considered. Mere submission of an online application does not confer any right for consideration unless duly forwarded through proper channel. Applications received after the last date or incomplete applications may not be considered. UIDAI reserves the right to post the selected officer at any other location or select a candidate for another location based on administrative reasons or exigency of service. The Authority reserves the right to withdraw this circular at any time, without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice invites applications for 1 vacancy (UIDAI may change the number at any time, in its discretion) for the post of Assistant Account Officer at the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Technology Centre, Bengaluru.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Officers from the Central Government holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre/department, or with three years of regular service in the Pay Matrix Level 7 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (Rs. 44,900 – Rs. 1,42,400) or with five years of regular service in the Pay Matrix Level-6 (Rs. 35,400 - Rs. 1,12,400); OR officers from State Government, Public Sector Undertaking, or Autonomous Organisation holding regular posts in corresponding grades with requisite experience. In addition, candidates must have professional qualifications of Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant / MBA (Finance); OR have passed the SAS / equivalent examination of an organized Accounts Cadre of Central/State Government; OR have successfully completed Cash & Accounts Training organised by ISTM; OR have at least five years’ experience in handling accounts related work. Basic skills for working in a computerized office environment. Only officers who have completed at least five years of government service may apply. Officers holding analogous posts in the parent organisation may be preferred. Minimum residual service should be 3 years as on the closing date for the application. Private candidates are not eligible since the post is to be filled up on deputation basis. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The period of deputation shall be five years. The lending organisation may relieve an officer for a lesser period, as per its policy/rules/regulations, subject to a minimum of three years. Salary, allowances, joining time, medical benefits, and travelling allowance shall be as per the provisions of the Unique Identification Authority of India (Appointment of Officers and Employees) Regulations, 2020 and the Unique Identification Authority of India (Salary, Allowances and other Terms and Conditions of Service of Employees) Regulations, 2020. Leave shall be regulated by the Central Civil Services (Leave) Rules, 1972, and DoPT guidelines. In case of appointment from an organisation whose pay structure and/or Dearness Allowance pattern is dissimilar to that in UIDAI, only the pay shall be protected and not the perquisites.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for UIDAI Assistant Account Officer
content_sections.text: Eligible and interested officers must submit their application online through the UIDAI Career Portal at https://career.uidai.gov.in. After submission of the online application, download and print the duly filled online application form generated through the Career Portal. Submit the signed hard copy of the application to your Cadre Controlling Authority or Parent Organisation for forwarding through proper channel. Ensure the Cadre Controlling Authority forwards the application along with cadre clearance, vigilance/disciplinary clearance, ACRs/APARs for the last five years duly attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India or an officer of equivalent rank, and the certificate in the prescribed format at Annex-I. Forward the complete application along with all requisite documents to: Director (HR), Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Aadhaar Complex, NTI Layout, Tata Nagar, Kodigehalli, Technology Centre, Bengaluru – 560 092, so that it is received by 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify a written examination or interview stage. Selection is conducted on a deputation basis among eligible officers whose services are spared by their parent organisation and forwarded through proper channel.

content_sections.heading: UIDAI Assistant Account Officer Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Individuals who apply for the post may not withdraw their candidature subsequently. Private candidates are not eligible as the post is filled on deputation basis. Only applications submitted online through the UIDAI Career Portal and subsequently forwarded through proper channel with all requisite documents will be considered. Mere submission of an online application does not confer any right for consideration unless duly forwarded through proper channel. Applications received after the last date or incomplete applications may not be considered. UIDAI reserves the right to post the selected officer at any other location or select a candidate for another location based on administrative reasons or exigency of service. The Authority reserves the right to withdraw this circular at any time, without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post available in UIDAI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UIDAI is recruiting for the post of Assistant Account Officer on a deputation basis (on Foreign Service terms).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced in this notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available, though UIDAI reserves the right to change the number at its discretion.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UIDAI Assistant Account Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of complete applications through proper channel is 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be below 56 years of age as on the closing date for the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess professional qualifications of Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant / MBA (Finance), or have passed the SAS/equivalent examination, or completed Cash & Accounts Training by ISTM, or have at least 5 years of experience in handling accounts related work, along with the required government service grade.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Assistant Account Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a pay scale in Pay Level-8 of the 7th Central Pay Commission (Rs. 47,600 – Rs. 1,51,100).

faq.question: Q7. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The posting is at the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), Technology Centre, Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, the post is filled on a deputation basis and private candidates are not eligible.

faq.question: Q9. How should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply online through the UIDAI Career Portal at https://career.uidai.gov.in and then submit the signed hard copy through their Cadre Controlling Authority to the Director (HR) at UIDAI Technology Centre, Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q10. Can private candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, private candidates are not eligible since the post is to be filled up on deputation basis from government, PSU, or autonomous organisation officers.
